thread:
mike_acme: Hey, SSO started failing for our users ~6:30am UTC after our IdP metadata update. We rotated signing keys yesterday. Now users hit 401SAML: Recipient mismatch or signature invalid. Can you triage?

aya-support: Sorry about that — can you share the IdP metadata URL and a couple of auth log lines (SAMLResponse Errors)? Also confirm the SP ACS URL you're sending in the AuthnRequest.

mike_acme: Metadata: https://idp.acme-corp.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml
SP ACS: https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/consume (we have a proxy that adds :443)
Auth log excerpt: "SAMLResponse: SignatureVerificationFailed fingerprint mismatch (expected SHA1: ab:cd:... got ef:01:...)"

aya-support: thanks — two quick checks: 1) can you run curl -I and one raw GET from a few locations? 2) can you paste the raw SAMLResponse (or at least the KeyInfo/Sig fingerprint) if possible.

mike_acme: Running from my laptop and from our CI (eu-west):
```
$ curl -I https://idp.acme-corp.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml
HTTP/2 204 
server: Fastly
content-length: 0
x-cache: HIT
date: Tue, 05 Mar 2024 06:40:12 GMT

$ curl -s https://idp.acme-corp.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml | head -n 5
<--- EMPTY --->
```
From browser in US it loads fine (200 + xml).

aya-support: aha — interesting. Our metadata fetcher does conditional requests and will treat a 204 as empty response (no new metadata) which means we keep the old metadata (old cert) -> leads to signature mismatch when IdP rotated keys. Could be CDN edge returning 204 to conditional GETs incorrectly.

samir-eng: adding logs from our side (pulled from metadata fetcher):
```
2024-03-05T06:39:58Z INFO fetcher: GET https://idp.acme-corp.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml If-Modified-Since: Tue, 05 Mar 2024 00:00:00 GMT
2024-03-05T06:40:12Z WARN fetcher: received 204 No Content for metadata url, treating as no-update
2024-03-05T06:40:12Z ERROR saml: Signature verification failed: fingerprint mismatch (expected SHA256: aa:bb:cc..., metadata cert id=old-key-1)
2024-03-05T06:40:13Z DEBUG xmlsec: key type=ecdsa, curve=P-256
2024-03-05T06:40:13Z ERROR xmlsec: unsupported digest algorithm for key type ecdsa -> signature check failed
```

aya-support: two things to confirm: 1) Did IdP publish only ECDSA signing key (no RSA fallback)? 2) Did they change CDN behavior to return 204 for conditional requests?

mike_acme: They said they switched to ECDSA-only and rolled it through a CDN. Browser shows 200 because CDN edge in my region has updated content; some edges return 204 for conditional GETs which confuses clients.

jess-oncall: pinging eng-oncall — @samir-eng, do we need to update our metadata fetcher to retry or accept 204 as a signal to re-fetch unconditionally? Also, xmlsec complaining about ECDSA is concerning — which xmlsec/libxml versions are we running?

samir-eng: current xmlsec is 1.2.30 built against OpenSSL 1.1.1; it supports ECDSA generally but our SAML validation code assumes RSA for KeyInfo->X509 certificate parsing in a few codepaths. Quick triage: the auth library is ignoring KeyDescriptor with use="signing" when KeyInfo contains ECDSA SubjectPublicKeyInfo in some cases. Repro steps: we pulled IdP metadata from region that returned 204 -> we kept stale RSA cert in cache -> requests signed by new ECDSA key fail -> xmlsec then logs unsupported digest because our code attempted SHA1/SHA256 on ECDSA with a mismatch.

aya-support: For an immediate customer workaround: ask IdP to (A) re-publish metadata with both RSA and ECDSA KeyDescriptor entries (include an RSA fallback) OR (B) purge CDN so edge returns 200 for unconditional fetch and no 204 for conditional requests. Also ask them to set Content-Type: application/xml and ensure caching headers are correct.

mike_acme: I'll ask IdP. They responded: "we can add RSA as fallback and re-run the publish; also will check CDN config."

aya-support: Good. On our side I'll escalate to eng to add two mitigations: 1) make metadata fetcher treat 204 as possible CDN artifact and retry once without If-Modified-Since (ticket created SUP-9231), 2) audit SAML parsing path to ensure ECDSA certs in KeyDescriptor are accepted (ENG-1298).

samir-eng: I created ENG-1298 and pushed a small fix branch that: - accepts ECDSA X509 certs from KeyDescriptor properly, - falls back to SHA256 verification path for ECDSA. Not yet in prod.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by samir-eng: branch/eng-1298 -> staging (rollout id 8473)

aya-support: follow up with the customer: please confirm after IdP republishes. If they can add RSA fallback that's fastest. If they only want ECDSA, we'll push the staging patch and fast-track to prod next deploy window.

mike_acme: IdP added RSA fallback and purged CDN. I triggered a metadata refresh on our tenant: fetcher logs now show 200 and new cert fingerprint.
```
2024-03-05T07:02:21Z INFO fetcher: GET https://idp.acme-corp.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml -> 200, len=12.3KB
2024-03-05T07:02:21Z INFO fetcher: metadata updated, new signing cert fingerprint SHA256: ef:01:02:... (id=new-ecdsa-1)
2024-03-05T07:02:22Z INFO saml: Verified incoming signature using RSA fallback cert id=rsa-legacy
```

aya-support: Great — can you confirm logins succeed now for affected users?

mike_acme: Verified with 3 users in EU/US — all good. Thanks.

jess-oncall: I'll keep ENG-1298 assigned and try to get the xmlsec/saml parsing fix into prod next week; SUP-9231 will add a conservative retry on 204 to avoid future outages from CDN conditional responses.

aya-support: closing the support escalation for now — re-open if anything new pops up. :white_check_mark:

mike_acme: Thanks everyone! :tada:
